about: Every sentence tool:check-copy says that is not a rule's own: its refusals, its problems and its status words.

refused.no_units: Nothing to check: send text, texts, Markdown, value, units, html, decks or pictures.
refused.bad_rules: The rules must be a list of rule rows, or left out to use the grammar rows.
refused.no_checker: The person's-rules checker could not run: {why}

problems.approval_unproven: The approval for {id} is not the person's own words found literally in the source text sent with it.
problems.baseline_gone: {id} is in the baseline and is gone, with no approval carrying the person's own words.
problems.audience: Row {id} is public with audience {audience}; only {allowed} may publish.
problems.offer_short: Offer {id} lists {own} of the {every} lines the offers show; the other offers also show {missing}.
problems.count_unpublished: {label} carries counts but is not a published list view (schema {schema} with a source view): a count must resolve to a list published as a file, never to a walk of a folder.
problems.picture_unread: {path} has no recorded reading of its words.
problems.required_missing: {name} is missing from every public word. {why}

required.locked: It is a signature line: add variants beside it, never take it out.
required.gap: The port is missing it ({gap}); a port gap is a port task, so the line stays.
required.promised: It was promised in public; taking it out needs the person's own yes.
